title: Command An Army Codes – Working Codes & Free Gems (2026)
description: Find the latest working Command An Army codes for free Gems, plus redemption steps, expired codes, and troubleshooting tips. The list is updated regularly.

hero.heading: Command An Army Codes
hero.lead: Working Command An Army codes: RANKED, GUILD, PARRY, RAPIER, OPTIMIZE, WAR, and RELEASE. Redeem them after the tutorial from the Code button on the right side of the screen.

sections.heading: Working codes
sections.intro: Last checked Sep 29, 2026. Type each code in capitals, with no spaces. Copy is on the table so one wrong letter does not spoil the claim.

sections.heading: How to redeem
sections.intro: The button is in the game, not on the Roblox website. Claim one code at a time.

steps.heading: Launch the right game
steps.description: Open the game from the official Roblox page by Fight, Fight, Fight! A similar name in search is a different experience and will not take these codes.

steps.heading: Finish the tutorial
steps.description: Claim Mercenary, Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer when the lesson offers them. The Code button is ready after that lesson ends.

steps.heading: Open Code
steps.description: Click the Code button on the right side of the screen. The field is for the code, and the confirm control is Claim.

steps.heading: Enter one code
steps.description: Paste or type a single code from the working table. Keep the capitals. Do not add a space, a slash, or the word Gems.

steps.heading: Press Claim
steps.description: Wait until the Gems are added, then repeat for the next code. Claiming the same code twice on one account does not pay a second time.

sections.heading: Older codes
paragraphs: The seven rewards add up to 2,900 Gems when every code claims: RANKED, GUILD, PARRY, and RAPIER pay 300 each, OPTIMIZE pays 700, and WAR and RELEASE pay 500 each. That total only arrives if this account has not used the code before. Gems go to the lobby summon area. They do not raise mastery by themselves, and they do not equip a troop that breaks your Star Limit.

This page lists codes that are working. A string that is not in the table is not a plan. Some older words still get copied in comments and videos. Try one only if you already saw it in the Discord announcement for this game, and stop when Claim rejects it.
A rejection means the code is already used on this account, typed wrong, or no longer pays. It does not mean the working table is empty. Do not build a summon around a code that is not listed here.

sections.heading: Why a code may not work
paragraphs: A failed claim is usually one of five things. Check them in this order before you assume the whole list is dead.

subsections.heading: The tutorial is not finished
paragraphs: The Code button is part of the live game. If you are still inside the opening lesson, finish it, claim the opening troops, and look at the right edge again.

subsections.heading: The spelling or case is off
paragraphs: These codes are short words in capitals. A missing letter makes a live code look invalid. OPTIMIZE is the easy one to mistype. Use Copy on the working table, then paste into the field with nothing else attached.

subsections.heading: This account already claimed it
paragraphs: Codes are a one-time grant per account. If you redeemed RELEASE last week, typing it again will not add another 500 Gems. Use another account only if that account is yours. Do not share a login to test a code.

subsections.heading: The code no longer pays
paragraphs: Codes get turned off without a long warning. That is why strings outside the working table are not treated as reliable here. A code that worked in a video last week can fail today. Stay with the seven codes above.

subsections.heading: You are in the wrong experience
paragraphs: Roblox search shows other army and command games. Their codes will not redeem here, and these codes will not redeem there. The place you want is the Fight, Fight, Fight! game linked from this site.

sections.heading: Where new codes show up
paragraphs: New codes are normally posted in the game Discord before they are repeated anywhere else. The invite is [discord.gg/commandrblx](https://discord.gg/commandrblx). The [Fight, Fight, Fight! Roblox community](https://www.roblox.com/communities/1014980424/Fight-Fight-Fight) is the group behind the game, and the [official game page](https://www.roblox.com/games/101770480176177) is where an update banner shows up. There is no public Trello for codes. A Trello login, a direct-message verifier, or a script file is not how these rewards are delivered.

Read the announcement, then redeem inside the game. The [Discord page](/discord/) explains how to confirm you joined the server that matches this game. After the Gems arrive, decide what they are for. A summon you cannot equip is a star-cap problem, not a code problem. The [tier list](/tier-list/) is what to field, and the [units roster](/units/) shows which names you are given, which you summon, and which you evolve. If this is your first session, follow the [beginner guide](/beginner-guide/) before you spend the whole stack on one 4-star.

A useful order is simple. Redeem every working code once. Look at the three troop slots and the star cap on the loadout screen. New accounts start at 6 stars. Summon only when a slot is actually weak, and leave a rare pull in storage if it does not fit beside a shield and a ranged troop. Codes are the fast start. They are not a repeating payout, so the matches after the claims are what keep the account moving.

faq.question: What are the working Command An Army codes?
faq.answer: RANKED, GUILD, PARRY, RAPIER, OPTIMIZE, WAR, and RELEASE. The rewards are 300, 300, 300, 300, 700, 500, and 500 Gems. Last checked Sep 29, 2026.

faq.question: How do I redeem codes in Command An Army?
faq.answer: Finish the tutorial, click Code on the right side of the screen, enter the code exactly, and press Claim. Repeat for each code you have not already used on that account.

faq.question: Are Command An Army codes case sensitive?
faq.answer: Enter them exactly as listed. The working codes are capitals with no spaces. A wrong letter is rejected even when the code is still live.

faq.question: Why did my code say it failed?
faq.answer: The usual causes are an unfinished tutorial, a typo, a code you already claimed, a code that no longer pays, or the wrong Roblox game. Use the working table before you retry an older string.

faq.question: Do codes give units directly?
faq.answer: These codes pay Gems, not a named unit. You spend Gems in the lobby summon area. Equipping what you pull still depends on your Star Limit.

faq.question: How often are new codes added?
faq.answer: There is no fixed calendar. New codes usually appear in the commandrblx Discord first. Check that server, then redeem inside the game.

faq.question: Can I redeem the same code twice?
faq.answer: No. A code that already paid on your account will not pay a second time. The reward is tied to the account, not to each match.

title: How to Evolve Units in Command An Army – Evolution Guide
description: How to evolve units in Command An Army, including mastery level 20, current evolution paths, and how evolution differs from ascension.
keywords: how to evolve units in Command An Army
how to evolve in Command An Army

hero.heading: How to Evolve Units in Command An Army
hero.lead: Here is how to evolve units in Command An Army: raise the unit to Mastery 20, open the Evolution station, select an eligible unit, check the cost, and confirm.

sections.heading: Evolve a unit
sections.intro: Do this for one project at a time. Mastery only moves when that troop is in the match.

steps.heading: Raise the unit to Mastery 20
steps.description: Equip the troop and play matches. Mastery is the level on that unit, and it stops at 20. Account level is a different number. A level 20 Archer does not unlock evolution on a Shieldman.

steps.heading: Go to the Evolution station
steps.description: In the lobby, use the Evolution station rather than the ascension station. Ascension merges a duplicate. Evolution changes this copy into the next name.

steps.heading: Select an eligible unit
steps.description: The unit must be Mastery 20 and it must have a path. If it is missing, recheck the level. Spartan, Immortal, Samurai, Berserker, Mace, and Crossbowman will not appear just because they are strong.

steps.heading: Check the required cost
steps.description: Check the Evolution station in-game for the current cost before confirming the upgrade.

steps.heading: Confirm evolution
steps.description: After the change, open the loadout. The new form is a different card, often with a higher star cost. Plan to level that new form again before a second evolution, and unequip something else if the new stars no longer fit.

sections.heading: Evolution paths
sections.intro: Some cards use a second spelling. Halberder and Halberdier are the same line. Flame Archers and Flaming Archers are the same line. The in-game evolve list is the final check if a patch adds or removes a step.
paragraphs: Eight families have a next form. The mercenary, shield, spear, and archer lines start from troops you are given. Cavalry, militia, halberd, and javelin start from a summon. A 4-star summon such as Spartan is already the finished card. You can still level it and ascend it. You cannot evolve it into a new name.

table.caption: Evolution paths. Star costs are the figures on these forms.
rows: 1★ to 2★ to 3★. A front line you can build without a rare summon.
1★ to 2★ to 3★. Ends in a hold specialist.
1★ to 2★. The short anti-cavalry line from the opening spear.
1★ to 2★ to 3★. Flame Archers is the ranged form used for damage, with burn.
2★ to 3★ to 4★. Lancer is the mounted payoff.
2★ into a 3★ formed spear. Better on Hold than on a blind charge.
2★ into a 3★ polearm. Block damage against shields.
2★ into a 3★ thrown unit. A ranged answer that is not the archer line.

sections.heading: Evolution and ascension
paragraphs: These four words show up on the same lobby screens and they do different jobs. Using the wrong one is the expensive mistake.

table.caption: Four progression systems that are easy to mix up.
rows: Unit level, up to 20. Level 20 is the evolution gate.
A level 20 unit that has a path, plus the cost on the evolve screen
The troop becomes the next name. Star cost usually rises. Level it again for another step.
A duplicate of the same unit at the same ascension level
The kept copy gets stronger. It stops at ascension 3 and raises damage and HP. The name stays the same.
How many stars you may equip at once. It does not evolve a unit. New accounts start at 6 stars and three troop slots.

subsections.heading: Ascension does not change the name
paragraphs: The ascension station merges two copies of the same troop so duplicates are not wasted and the inventory does not fill with spare copies. The result is a stronger version of that same name, up to ascension 3. It is worth doing on the troop you field. It is not how Archer becomes Flame Archers.

subsections.heading: Stars are a cost, not an evolution stage
paragraphs: A star on the card is the loadout price and a rough rarity mark. Evolution often adds a star because the next form is a stronger troop, which is why Lancer is 4-star even though you built it from a 2-star rider. You cannot star up Spartan into a new unit. Spartan already is the unit. A fourth troop slot opens around account level 15. If the loadout screen shows a different cap, use the screen.

subsections.heading: Deleting is the last option
paragraphs: Delete a unit only after ascension 3, because that is when the game returns a small Gem refund. The amount is on the delete prompt. A spare copy is ascension material until that cap. A level 20 copy on a real path is evolution material. Trash neither of those to clear a slot in a hurry.

sections.heading: Which units to evolve first
paragraphs: There is no developer ranking of evolution order. Evolve the line you can field now whose final form still has a job later. A project that sits in storage never reaches 20.

subsections.heading: Archer, if you want ranged damage
paragraphs: Archer is weak at 1 star and strong as a project. The line ends at Flame Archers: long range and a burn on hit. You can start this on day one because Archer is free. Protect it with a shield or a spear while mastery climbs, or it will spend the match dead and gain nothing.

subsections.heading: Scout Rider, if you want a Lancer
paragraphs: Scout Rider is a 2-star summon, so this project begins when the banner gives you one. Cavalryman is already a real mounted troop. Lancer is the 4-star end. The star jump is the catch. Plan the rest of the squad so a 4-star cavalry piece still leaves room for someone who can hold.

subsections.heading: Shieldman, if points are slipping
paragraphs: Imperial Wall is the end of the shield line and the troop you bring when the job is Hold, not a damage race. It will not replace Flame Archers. It keeps those archers alive. Evolve this when your losses are that you got pushed off the point, not that you could not kill their wall.

subsections.heading: A spear or a halberd, for a specific answer
paragraphs: Pikeman and Spear Vanguard answer cavalry without a 4-star pull. Imperial Halberder is the block-damage polearm for shield stacks. Evolve the one that matches the squads you are actually losing to. A second project in parallel only works if both troops fit in the same loadout, because the one you leave at home does not gain mastery.

subsections.heading: Grinding a unit with no path
paragraphs: Spartan, Immortal, Samurai, and Berserker are strong because of what they already are. Extra matches make that copy better at its job. They do not open an evolve button. Check the path table before you dedicate a week to one name.

subsections.heading: Evolving into a star cap you cannot afford
paragraphs: The exciting step is Lancer or Flame Archers. The next screen is the loadout refusing the squad. Evolve when the new star total still leaves you a front unit and, for archers, a body in front of them.

subsections.heading: Merging the copy you meant to evolve
paragraphs: Ascension consumes a duplicate. If you only have two Archers and one of them is close to 20, do not confirm ascension because the stations sit near each other. Read the header on the menu.

subsections.heading: Spreading mastery across eight troops
paragraphs: You have three troop slots at the start and four later. Most of the roster is not in the match. Pick one evolution project, keep it equipped, and let the others wait. A roster of level 8 troops has nothing to evolve.

subsections.heading: Trusting an old screenshot over the screen
paragraphs: Early path lists stopped the archer line at Longbowman. Flame Archers is the later step. If a new troop appears, believe the evolve screen over a saved image of this table.

sections.heading: Where to go next
paragraphs: The [units](/units/) page is the roster and the role of each name. The [tier list](/tier-list/) is the practical judgment of what those final forms are worth under a star cap. If you do not have a level 20 unit yet, the [beginner guide](/beginner-guide/) is the faster route to a legal squad and the codes that fund summons.

faq.question: How do you evolve units in Command An Army?
faq.answer: Use the unit until its mastery level is 20, open the lobby Evolution station, select that unit, check the cost, and confirm. The unit must have an evolution path.

faq.question: What level do you need to evolve?
faq.answer: Mastery level 20 on that unit. Account level 20 is a different number and is about your Star Limit, not the evolve button.

faq.question: Can every unit evolve?
faq.answer: No. Paths exist for the opening lines plus Scout Rider, Spear Militia, Halberder, and Javelineer. Spartan, Immortal, Samurai, Berserker, Mace, and Crossbowman have no next form.

faq.question: Is evolution the same as ascension?
faq.answer: No. Evolution changes the troop into the next name at Mastery 20. Ascension merges duplicate copies of the same name, stops at ascension 3, and raises damage and HP.

faq.question: Does evolution reset the unit?
faq.answer: Plan to level the new form again before a further evolution. Open the card after you confirm and read the new mastery and star cost.

faq.question: What should I evolve first?
faq.answer: Archer if you want Flame Archers, Scout Rider if you want Lancer, and Shieldman if you need a unit that can hold a point. Only evolve a troop you can still equip afterward.

faq.question: Do 4-star units evolve?
faq.answer: Lancer reaches 4 stars by evolution. The 4-star summons Spartan, Immortal, Samurai, and Berserker do not have a next form.

title: Command An Army Tier List – Best Units Ranked (2026)
description: A practical Command An Army tier list for late September 2026, with role notes and Star Limit advice for building a squad.

hero.heading: Command An Army Tier List
hero.lead: Command An Army tier list for the roster as of Sep 29, 2026. This ranking is practical, not official.

sections.heading: The ranking
sections.intro: S is a troop you build toward when the stars fit. A wins a job or bridges into S. B is a real piece with a condition. C is cheap, or the start of a better line. Within a tier, the order is not a damage ranking.

table.caption: S to C, with the job each troop does.
rows: Top of the practical list. Breaks shields and stays in a long fight.
Durable hold piece. Block-damage weapons are the counter.
Final mounted form. Charge and speed, if you have room and spears are not braced.
Ranged troop used for damage, with burn. Needs a front line.
Hits hard and has little protection. Field it when the squad can start the fight.
Fast pressure, less armor than Spartan. A commit tool, not a wall.
Answer to shields when you cannot spend four stars.
The step before Lancer, and already a mounted threat.
Formed spears for receiving a charge. Better on defense than as a chaser.
Hold specialist at the end of the Shieldman line.
End of the Mercenary line. A front unit you can build without a rare pull.
Direct ranged damage. Weaker than Flame Archers if the screen collapses.
The javelin upgrade. A ranged tool outside the archer line.
Block damage into shields. The reason to keep a Halberder.
Stronger than Archer and the step before Flame Archers.
Early mobility and the start of the Lancer line.
Middle of the shield line until Imperial Wall.
Cheap anti-cavalry from the opening spear.
Middle of the mercenary line toward Knight.
Filler and the start of Knight.
Cheap hold piece and the start of Imperial Wall.
Cheap anti-cavalry and the start of Pikeman.
Weak in a fight, valuable because the line ends at Flame Archers.
Field it for block damage, then look at Imperial Halberder.
A stopgap thrower on the way to Elite Javelineer.

sections.heading: Best units
paragraphs: Samurai, Spartan, Lancer, and Flame Archers are the names to build toward. Immortal belongs with them when your squad can protect it, because it hits hard and has little protection. Mace is the shield-break pick when a 4-star will not fit.

Best units still lose to the star cap. New accounts start at 6 stars and three slots. A fourth slot opens around account level 15. One S-tier body can be the wrong squad. Read the role before you delete the cheap troop that was holding the point. If the loadout screen shows a different cap, the screen wins.

subsections.heading: S tier
paragraphs: Samurai pressures a shield line and does not need a trick setup to be useful. It costs 4 stars, so it is a cornerstone, not a fourth body you casually add. Put a 1-star shield or archer beside it when the cap is still 6. Do not pair it with Spartan until the cap grows.

Spartan is the other 4-star players trust on a point. Shields hold ground and block ranged fire. They give that advantage back when the other side brings block damage, which is why Mace, halberds, and Samurai are the answer. Spartan is S because the hold is that good, not because it has no counter.

Lancer is the cavalry payoff. You do not summon it as a base unit. You evolve Scout Rider through Cavalryman. Use the charge after something else has fixed the enemy, then leave. Riding it into a braced spear line is how an S troop spends the round on the ground.

Flame Archers is the ranged pick, with arcing shots and burn. Every ranged troop is a positioning troop. With Imperial Wall or Spartan in front, it shoots. Alone on the point, cavalry deletes it. The 3-star cost is kinder than a 4-star melee, which is why the archer project is such a good early plan.

Immortal stays in S with a warning. The offense is high and the defense is thin, and it has a bad time into archers if you send it in alone. Field it when your squad can start the fight. Do not field it as your only front unit.

subsections.heading: A tier
paragraphs: Berserker wants to arrive quickly and does not want to stand there. The pressure is real and the mistakes are less forgiving than Spartan. Mace is different: at 3 stars it is the shield breaker you can afford beside something else. It is a tool, not a whole squad.

Cavalryman, Spear Vanguard, Imperial Wall, and Knight each solve a job you can name. Cavalryman is the mounted step you can use before Lancer fits. Spear Vanguard receives charges. Imperial Wall holds. Knight is the frontliner at the end of a free line. None of them needs a rare summon except the time you spend evolving them.

subsections.heading: B tier and C tier
paragraphs: B tier is where bridge units and conditional tools live. Longbowman, Scout Rider, Sentinel, and Squire are mid because their job is to become something else. Crossbowman, Elite Javelineer, and Imperial Halberder are mid because they are good in a slot and bad as the whole plan. Pikeman and Spear Militia win when horses are the problem and lose when you needed a wall.

C tier is not a delete list. Mercenary, Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer are the troops the game hands you, and three of those lines end in A or S forms. Halberder and Javelineer are C as base cards because you are usually happier after the evolution, not because a polearm has no use. A C troop on the point is better than an S troop stuck in inventory.

sections.heading: How role changes the pick
paragraphs: A tier letter collapses five different jobs into one column. The jobs are why two S troops can still form a bad squad, and why a B troop keeps its slot.

subsections.heading: Frontline and shields
paragraphs: Spartan, Imperial Wall, Sentinel, and Shieldman stand on the point and take the first hit. They make ranged troops possible. They are the bodies Mace, Samurai, and halberds are built to remove. A shield-only squad looks safe until the other team stops shooting arrows and starts swinging weapons that ignore the block.

subsections.heading: Spears and polearms
paragraphs: Spearman, Pikeman, Spear Militia, and Spear Vanguard are the braced answer to cavalry. Halberder and Imperial Halberder lean into shields instead. Spears want Hold and a formation. They are worse when you Rush them across the map, because the brace is the weapon.

subsections.heading: Cavalry
paragraphs: Scout Rider, Cavalryman, and Lancer buy speed. Attackers use that to reach the next point. Both sides use it to hit archers who stepped past their line. Cavalry loses the trade it starts into spears. Charge, then leave. Do not park a Lancer on Hold and hope.

subsections.heading: Ranged
paragraphs: Archer, Longbowman, Flame Archers, Crossbowman, and the javelin line shoot. Flame Archers is the damage pick, because of the burn and the arc. All of them need a front unit. There is no healer in the roster, so the support you actually have is a shield, a spear brace, or an order. Longbowman matters before Flame Archers, Pikeman matters into horses, and Mace matters into shields.

sections.heading: Best units by role
paragraphs: Use this when the tier letter and the star cap disagree. The pick is the troop that does the job you are missing, not the highest letter you own.

table.caption: Role picks when the star cap will not hold the first choice.
columns: If the stars do not fit
rows: Imperial Wall, or Shieldman until that evolution exists
A front line you can build
Squire or Mercenary while mastery climbs

sections.heading: How to build from the list
paragraphs: Add the stars before you fall in love with a row. Under a cap of 6, Spartan plus anything meaningful is already the whole squad. Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer fit together and still do three jobs. That is a better hour than owning Samurai and fighting with two empty slots.

Attack and defend do not want the same bias. Attackers need to reach Capture Point A, then B, then the capture base, so a cavalry piece or a fast melee earns the slot. Defenders need Hold, a spear for the charge they know is coming, and a ranged troop that never stands in front. Switching orders does not fix a squad that is four archers.

Evolution and ascension move a troop more than a fresh summon does. A mastered Flame Archers is not the same card as a level 1 Archer, even though the table has to list both. Evolve the line you field, and read [how to evolve units](/how-to-evolve-units/) before you spend mastery on a name with no path. Obtain method and star cost live on the [units page](/units/). [Working codes](/codes/) fund the next summon. They do not bypass the star cap.

faq.question: What is the best unit in Command An Army?
faq.answer: There is no single official best unit. Samurai, Spartan, Lancer, and Flame Archers are the names to build toward. Immortal belongs with them if your squad can protect it.

faq.question: Is this the official Command An Army tier list?
faq.answer: No. It is a practical ranking for players, not an official chart.

faq.question: Why is Archer low if Flame Archers is high?
faq.answer: Archer is weak at 1 star and is the first step of the ranged line. You keep it because it evolves into Flame Archers, not because the 1-star card wins fights today.

faq.question: Are 4-star units always worth equipping?
faq.answer: Only if the rest of the squad still fits. A 4-star summon can crowd out the shield, the spear, or the archer you needed for the point.

faq.question: Which unit should I evolve for the tier list?
faq.answer: Archer toward Flame Archers, or Scout Rider toward Lancer, are the two projects that end in S-tier names you do not pull as base units. Shieldman toward Imperial Wall is the hold project.

faq.question: Does the tier change between attack and defend?
faq.answer: The letters do not, but the slot does. Defend wants Hold, spears, and a screened archer. Attack wants something that can reach the next point after the current one is taken.

faq.question: When was this tier list reviewed?
faq.answer: Sep 29, 2026. If a new troop appears in your inventory, use the in-game card until you have played with it.

title: Command An Army Units – All Units & Evolution Paths
description: Command An Army units, with roles, star costs, how to obtain them, and the evolution paths documented for this version.

hero.heading: Command An Army Units
hero.lead: Command An Army units are the troops you equip under a Star Limit. The roster below lists role, stars, how you get each one, and its evolution.

sections.heading: Unit roster
sections.intro: Twenty-six troops, including evolutions. A star is both a rarity mark and a loadout cost. Summon means the lobby banner. None means that card has no known evolution.

table.caption: Roster, roles, stars, and evolutions.
rows: Final form of the opening spear

sections.heading: How to read a troop
paragraphs: A unit is a troop card, not your commander. You bring a handful of them into a 12-player match, stand in the fight yourself, and give Follow, Hold, Attack, or Rush. The four troops given at the start are Mercenary, Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer. Everything else is a summon or an evolution of one of those lines.

Stars add up against your Star Limit. New accounts start at 6 stars and three slots, with a fourth slot around account level 15. If the loadout screen shows different numbers, use the screen. That is why the roster is larger than any squad you can field. Owning Samurai does not mean Samurai is in the match.

Halberder and Halberdier are the same card. Flame Archers and Flaming Archers are the same card. For a judgment of what to field, use the [tier list](/tier-list/). This page tells you what the troop is and how it connects to the others.

sections.heading: Roles
paragraphs: Role is how the troop behaves when you give an order. Cover the jobs before you stack four cards from the same column.

subsections.heading: Shields
paragraphs: Shieldman, Sentinel, Imperial Wall, and Spartan are the hold tools. Put them on the point with Hold when the other team has archers or a straight push. They are the wrong last unit against Mace, Samurai, and halberds, which deal block damage or break shields. A shield is a screen for your ranged troop, not a promise that you cannot be moved.

subsections.heading: Spears and polearms
paragraphs: Spearman, Pikeman, Spear Militia, and Spear Vanguard brace against cavalry. They want the enemy to come to them. Halberder and Imperial Halberder are the polearm branch aimed at shields rather than horses. If riders run through you, add a spear. If their wall never breaks, add a halberd or a Mace.

subsections.heading: Infantry and heavy melee
paragraphs: Mercenary, Squire, and Knight are the buildable infantry line. Samurai, Immortal, and Berserker are the 4-star summons that skip that climb. They do not share an evolution. Knight is how you get a real frontliner without a rare pull. Samurai is the shield-pressure piece if the banner allows it and the star cap allows it.

subsections.heading: Cavalry
paragraphs: Scout Rider, Cavalryman, and Lancer are one family. They cross ground, they threaten archers, and they suffer into a spear line that was allowed to set. On attack they are how you arrive at the next point with the squad instead of after it. On defense they are a punish tool, not the body you park on the flag.

subsections.heading: Ranged and thrown
paragraphs: Archer, Longbowman, and Flame Archers are one family, and Flame Archers is the form with burn. Crossbowman is a separate 3-star summon with no evolution. Javelineer and Elite Javelineer throw. All of them want a body in front. There is no healer. The support you actually have is a shield, a spear brace, or an order.

sections.heading: Evolution families
paragraphs: Eight families have a next form. The other cards are complete when you summon them. Full steps, the Mastery 20 gate, and the difference from ascension are in [how to evolve units](/how-to-evolve-units/).

table.caption: Families and what the last form is for.
rows: A frontliner you can finish without a 4-star pull
Ranged damage, ending at Flame Archers
Speed and charge, ending at 4 stars
A formed spear that wants to receive a charge
Thrown attacks outside the archer line

subsections.heading: Cards with no next form
paragraphs: Spartan, Immortal, Samurai, Berserker, Mace, and Crossbowman show None in the roster. You still level them, and you can still ascend them with duplicates up to ascension 3. You cannot turn Mace into a second name by hitting Mastery 20. Lancer is 4-star because the cavalry line evolves into it, which is different from pulling a 4-star that stops there.

sections.heading: Loadout
paragraphs: Start from the jobs, then spend stars. A working squad for a new account is a shield or spear that can stand on the point, one ranged card behind it, and a third body that answers the thing killing you. Mercenary, Shieldman, and Archer fit that shape inside a 6-star cap. Swap Spearman in when riders are the problem. When a Scout Rider drops, it replaces Mercenary if you care about the Lancer line more than the Knight line.

Add a 4-star only by removing stars somewhere else. Samurai plus a 1-star shield plus a 1-star archer is a legal 6-star squad with a real plan. Samurai plus Spartan is not a squad you can field at that cap. The [tier list](/tier-list/) tells you which name to field. The loadout screen tells you whether today will allow it.

Attackers should keep one unit that can cross ground after a point flips, because the round is a chain of points ending at the capture base. Defenders should keep the brace and the screen, because their win condition is the push that never arrives. Follow groups the squad before you move. Hold is the order once you are on the point you mean to keep. Rush is for a line that is already breaking, not for the opening step.

Keep duplicates of the troop you ascend, and keep using the copy you want to evolve. [Codes](/codes/) buy more summons. They do not level mastery. If the first hour is still confusing, the [beginner guide](/beginner-guide/) puts these choices in order.

faq.question: How many Command An Army units are there?
faq.answer: The roster table lists 26 names, counting evolutions. If a new card appears in your inventory, the in-game index is the one to follow.

faq.question: What units do you start with?
faq.answer: Mercenary, Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer. You equip three of them at the start. A fourth slot opens around account level 15.

faq.question: What does the star number mean?
faq.answer: It is the troop's rarity mark and its cost against your Star Limit. The equipped stars cannot add up past the cap shown on the loadout screen.

faq.question: Which units evolve?
faq.answer: The mercenary, shield, opening spear, archer, cavalry, militia, halberd, and javelin lines. Spartan, Immortal, Samurai, Berserker, Mace, and Crossbowman have no known evolution.

faq.question: How do I get Spartan or Samurai?
faq.answer: They are 4-star summons from the lobby banner. They are not given at the start, and they are not evolutions. Pulling one still requires star room before you can equip it.

faq.question: Where is the best-unit ranking?
faq.answer: On the tier list. This page is the roster and the paths.

title: Command An Army Beginner Guide – Tips & Progression
description: A Command An Army beginner guide for the first hour: tutorial orders, codes, Star Limit, early loadouts, and attack or defend.

hero.heading: Command An Army Beginner Guide
hero.lead: This Command An Army beginner guide is the first hour, in order: finish the tutorial, redeem codes, set a first loadout, learn the Star Limit, then start one evolution.

sections.heading: First hour, in order
sections.intro: Do these five things before you chase a rare summon. The later sections explain each one.

steps.heading: Finish the tutorial
steps.description: Stay until the lesson ends. You learn Follow, Hold, Attack, and Rush, and you claim Mercenary, Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer.

steps.heading: Redeem the working codes
steps.description: Open Code on the right, claim RANKED, GUILD, PARRY, RAPIER, OPTIMIZE, WAR, and RELEASE once each, and stop. The codes page has Copy buttons.

steps.heading: Set a first loadout
steps.description: Equip Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer inside the star cap. Leave Mercenary as the spare front line or the Knight project.

steps.heading: Learn the Star Limit
steps.description: New accounts start at 6 stars and three troop slots. A fourth slot opens around account level 15. If the loadout screen shows different numbers, use the screen.

steps.heading: Pick one evolution project
steps.description: Keep Archer, Shieldman, or Spearman equipped so one of them can reach Mastery 20. Evolution is not a first-match button. Ascension can start as soon as you own a duplicate.

sections.heading: What you are playing
paragraphs: It is a free 12-player Roblox battle by Fight, Fight, Fight! You and a few troops take points. The other side tries to stop you, or you are the side stopping them. The maturity label is mild violence. Your commander is in the fight, not watching from a menu.

You choose attack or defend. You recruit troops, capture points, order formations, and upgrade what you collect. Kills matter when they clear a point. They do not matter when your squad is chasing someone away from the objective the round is scoring.

Attackers move through Capture Point A, then Capture Point B, then the capture base. Defenders win by keeping that chain from finishing. Search can hand you a different army game. Use the [official Roblox page](https://www.roblox.com/games/101770480176177). If the orders do not match what this guide describes, you are in the wrong place and the codes will not redeem.

sections.heading: Tutorial and orders
paragraphs: The tutorial is the only time the game forces the four orders. Stay until it ends. You get the opening troops at the end, and the code window behaves once that lesson is done.

Follow keeps the squad on you and is bound to C. Use it before you cross open ground, and use it again if the line is strung out. Hold plants the squad on a spot and is the order you want when enemies are incoming. Attack sends them at a target you choose. Rush commits them forward. Rush is the order new players spam, and it is the one that donates troops into a shield line.

Your own class is separate from the troops. Start on Sword and Shield so you can block while you learn the map. You can change class later. The live cost of that change is on the menu. You can also fight on a horse. It has its own health, and the roll gets you out of a swing once you are clear. Practice both in a quiet moment, not in the middle of the first point.

The lobby after the tutorial has the stations you will need all week. Summons spend Gems. The ascension station merges duplicates. The Evolution station is a different menu and will not do anything useful until a unit is Mastery 20. Codes are the Code button on the right during play, not a box on the website.

sections.heading: Codes before the first summon
paragraphs: Do this before the first banner pull. The working codes are RANKED, GUILD, PARRY, RAPIER, OPTIMIZE, WAR, and RELEASE. Their Gem rewards add up to 2,900 if every one claims. The [codes page](/codes/) has the copy buttons and the reasons a claim fails.

Open Code, paste one string, press Claim, and watch the Gems move. Then do the next. A code you already used on this account will not pay twice. A string from a different Roblox game will not pay at all. When the working list is done, stop. Guessing at older words is a worse use of the first session than playing a match.

sections.heading: A first loadout
paragraphs: Claim Mercenary, Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer. They are the 1-star troops given at the start. You can equip three. Pick Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer. Shieldman stands on the point. Spearman is there when a rider shows up. Archer is weak today and is the start of Flame Archers, so it should be in the squad often enough to gain mastery.

Mercenary waits as the Knight project or as a substitute if you need another cheap body. When a summon gives you Scout Rider, look at the stars before you celebrate. At 2 stars it may replace Mercenary, because that line ends at Lancer. It should not replace the only shield you have.

Ignore a 4-star pull you cannot surround. Samurai is excellent and costs 4 stars. Beside a 1-star shield and a 1-star archer it fits a 6-star cap. Beside Spartan it does not. If the game refuses to equip the new card, that is the cap, not a bug. Leave the rare card in storage until account level moves the limit. The names, stars, and paths are on the [units page](/units/). What is worth chasing is on the [tier list](/tier-list/).

sections.heading: Star Limit, attack, and defend
paragraphs: Star Limit is the sum of the stars on equipped troops. The starting cap is 6. It rises as the account levels from matches. A fourth troop slot opens around level 15. Both figures live on your loadout screen if a later patch changes them. Account level is not unit mastery. Mastery is the level on one troop, and 20 is the evolution gate.

Role balance beats a pile of damage. One unit holds or braces. One unit shoots from behind that body. One unit answers the loss you just had: a spear for horses, a Mace or halberd later for shields, a rider when you cannot reach the point. Four of the same role is how a squad gets one trick and then loses.

On defense, pick the point the objective names and use Hold. Let them walk into the spear and the shield. Do not Follow a single enemy back to their spawn and give up the flag. On attack, group with Follow, take the current point, then move to the next. Attackers can bring fresh troops from their spawn when a body dies. Defenders are trying to stop the push that makes that easy. If you are new, defend for a few rounds. The map tells you where the fight is, and Hold is easier to practice than a clean base race.

sections.heading: When evolution starts
paragraphs: Not in the first match. Evolution opens when one specific unit hits Mastery 20. That takes repeated games with that card equipped. Ascension can start sooner, whenever you own two copies of the same troop. Merge duplicates of the unit you use. Ascension stops at 3 and raises damage and HP. Do not delete those duplicates early. The small Gem refund for deleting a unit is for copies that have already reached ascension 3, and the amount is on the prompt.

Your first evolution project should be a troop you are already fielding. Archer toward Flame Archers is the ranged plan. Shieldman toward Imperial Wall is the hold plan. Spearman toward Pikeman is the anti-cavalry plan. Scout Rider toward Lancer starts only after you summon the rider. The steps are in [how to evolve units](/how-to-evolve-units/). Until something is level 20, the Evolution station can wait and the point cannot.

subsections.heading: Skipping the tutorial
paragraphs: You miss the order lesson, you delay the opening troops, and the code button is not ready. The tutorial is the fastest way through the first gate, even when it feels slow.

subsections.heading: Spending Gems before you read the star cap
paragraphs: Summon after you know you have three slots and a cap of 6. A rare pull you cannot equip is a picture in the inventory. The troops you already have can win a point tonight.

subsections.heading: Chasing kills off the point
paragraphs: Rush feels like playing. It also walks your archers into their riders. Hold the point you were given. Move when that point is done, not when a health bar runs away.

subsections.heading: Using the wrong lobby station
paragraphs: Ascension eats a duplicate. Evolution needs level 20 and a path. The stations are different. Read the title on the screen before you confirm, especially if you only own two copies of Archer.

subsections.heading: Joining a random Discord for codes
paragraphs: The server for this game is discord.gg/commandrblx. A similar name can be a different community. The [Discord page](/discord/) shows how to check before you talk.

sections.heading: A clock for the session
paragraphs: Use this as a clock, not a law. If a match runs long, finish the point before you tab out to summon. The order is what keeps the hour from turning into a pile of unused 4-stars.

table.caption: A first-session order for a new account.
rows: Join the official game and finish the tutorial
You can issue Follow, Hold, Attack, and Rush, and the opening troops are claimed
The Gems have been added once each
Equip Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer inside the star cap
The loadout screen accepts the squad
Play defense rounds on the named point
You have used Hold on a point and Follow between fights
Summon only if a slot is actually weak
Any new troop either fits the cap or stays in storage on purpose
Pick one evolution project and one ascension target
That project is equipped for the next matches, and spare copies were not deleted

faq.question: What should I do first in Command An Army?
faq.answer: Finish the tutorial, claim Mercenary, Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer, redeem the working codes, and equip three troops that fit the Star Limit before you summon.

faq.question: What are the troop orders?
faq.answer: Follow groups the squad on you and is bound to C. Hold keeps them on a spot. Attack sends them at a target. Rush charges them forward.

faq.question: Should I attack or defend as a beginner?
faq.answer: Defend for the first rounds. You practice Hold on a named point. Attack is the same orders plus the job of moving to the next point and then the base.

faq.question: What is a good first squad?
faq.answer: Shieldman, Spearman, and Archer. That covers hold, cavalry, and the start of the Flame Archers line inside a small star cap.

faq.question: When can I evolve?
faq.answer: When one equipped unit reaches Mastery 20 and has a path. That is later than the first hour. Ascension can start as soon as you have a duplicate.

faq.question: How do I get more Gems?
faq.answer: Redeem the working codes, then play matches and quests. Codes are the fast start. They are not a repeating payout.

faq.question: Which class should I pick?
faq.answer: Sword and Shield, so you can block while you learn troop orders. Change later if you want a different fight. The menu shows the live cost.

title: Command An Army Discord – Server Link & Community Guide
description: The Command An Army Discord at discord.gg/commandrblx, what players use it for, and how to avoid a similarly named server.

hero.heading: Command An Army Discord
hero.lead: Command An Army Discord: discord.gg/commandrblx. Last checked Sep 29, 2026. The server name is COMMAND AN ARMY.

sections.heading: What you can find there
sections.intro: Join [discord.gg/commandrblx](https://discord.gg/commandrblx), confirm the server name reads COMMAND AN ARMY, and then look for the channels the server itself marks. The game still lives on the [official Roblox page](https://www.roblox.com/games/101770480176177).
paragraphs: Use the server for codes, update posts, bug reports, and groups. Do not expect a second copy of the game, a private damage sheet, or a person who can restore a Roblox account. The [Fight, Fight, Fight! Roblox community](https://www.roblox.com/communities/1014980424/Fight-Fight-Fight) is the group behind the game. If that group later posts a different invite, use the newer link.

subsections.heading: Codes and update posts
paragraphs: New Gem codes are posted here before they are copied anywhere else. Update talk lands here too. There is no public Trello, so a random board is not the backup plan. After you see a code, redeem it from the Code button inside the game and compare it with the [codes page](/codes/) once that page has caught up. A code in chat is text. It is not a file, a macro, or a login.

subsections.heading: Bug reports and patch talk
paragraphs: Players report bugs and talk about balance patches in the server. That conversation does not change your squad tonight. If a troop feels different after an update, read the in-game card and play one match before you delete a line you were evolving. The loadout screen and the latest match are the live answers.

subsections.heading: Guilds and groups
paragraphs: Players use the server to find groups. Use the channel list after you join. A guild does not need your Roblox password, your email password, or a verification login on another site. If someone says it does, leave the message and keep playing.

subsections.heading: What it will not do
paragraphs: Nobody in the server can evolve a unit for you, raise your Star Limit, or refund a bad summon. Those happen in game. The [beginner guide](/beginner-guide/) is the route for a new account. Discord is where you hear that a code or a troop has changed.

sections.heading: How to join safely
paragraphs: A large server has real announcements and a lot of noise. The join itself should take a minute, and it should never ask for a Roblox password.

steps.heading: Use the known invite
steps.description: Type discord.gg/commandrblx yourself or use the link on this page. Do not scan a QR code from a comment, and do not use a shortened link that hides the destination.

steps.heading: Read the server name
steps.description: The server should be named COMMAND AN ARMY. If the name is a different game, leave before you talk.

steps.heading: Keep your login to yourself
steps.description: Nobody needs your Roblox password, your email password, or a verification login on another site. A direct message that asks for any of those is a scam, even if the avatar looks official.

steps.heading: Do not run files for rewards
steps.description: Codes are text you type into the Code button. They are not an executor, a macro, or a download. Close the message and redeem inside Roblox.

steps.heading: Prefer the marked channels
steps.description: Trading talk, arguments, and outdated codes sit next to real posts. Read the announcement channels the server marks, then test a code in game.

sections.heading: How to avoid lookalikes
paragraphs: A lookalike invite, commandanarmys, is for Slayers 2, not this game. Join discord.gg/commandrblx and confirm the server name is COMMAND AN ARMY. Member count and the word official do not make a different server the right one.

Check three things. The invite path is commandrblx. The server name is COMMAND AN ARMY. The same post also points at Roblox place 101770480176177 and the Fight, Fight, Fight! group. If a post has the right game name and the wrong place link, it is talking about something else.

Other Roblox games use army, command, or conquest in the title. Their servers can be real for those games and still be useless here. Their codes will fail in this Code box, and their troop lists are about different units. Leave, and come back through the link on this page.

If commandrblx ever stops working or the server renames, do not grab the next result in a search. Check the Fight, Fight, Fight! community on Roblox for whatever invite the group is posting, then play from the official game page. Until that happens, commandrblx is the invite to use.

You do not need Discord to play. The game is free on Roblox without it. Discord is how you hear about codes and updates sooner, and how you find a group if you want one. Redeem from the [codes page](/codes/) when you would rather stay in game, and use the beginner guide for the first hour either way. Never trade a password for a code, a guild slot, or a 'free unit'.

faq.question: What is the Command An Army Discord link?
faq.answer: discord.gg/commandrblx. The server name is COMMAND AN ARMY. Last checked Sep 29, 2026.

faq.question: Is this the developer's official Discord?
faq.answer: No. Join discord.gg/commandrblx, the COMMAND AN ARMY server players use for codes and updates. If the Fight, Fight, Fight! Roblox group posts a different invite, use that link.

faq.question: Where are codes posted?
faq.answer: New codes usually show up in that Discord first. Redeem them from the Code button inside the game. The codes page lists the ones that are working.

faq.question: Why does another Command An Army server exist?
faq.answer: Search results mix this game up with other communities. An invite such as commandanarmys, especially one that also mentions a different game such as Slayers 2, is not this server.

faq.question: Can Discord staff fix my Roblox account?
faq.answer: No. Do not send a password or a verification login. Account, ban, and purchase issues belong to Roblox. Troop questions belong in the game.

faq.question: Do I need Discord to play?
faq.answer: No. The game is free on Roblox without it. Discord is how you hear about codes and updates sooner. The beginner guide covers the first hour either way.
